''See also: [[Fury Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Fury is a powerful combatant and a member of a prominent family, recognized as the favored child of [[Malice]]. He is the father of the [[Sage]] [[Charity]] and holds the distinction of being the only direct descendant of [[Malice]] to reach the rank of [[Herald]]. His lineage and strength are significant, as he has progressed toward becoming a [[Monarch]] and has achieved the status of an [[Icon]]. Physically, he is a large figure characterized by glowing red eyes and wild, shadowy hair that moves as if underwater. While some cultures view him as a monster, he often presents a bright, conversational, or even playful demeanor, frequently expressing excitement or joy during combat. In battle, Fury is a formidable opponent who utilizes [[soulfire]] and [[Wind aura|wind aura]] to fly and move effortlessly. He wears seamless white [[Abidan]] armor and employs the techniques of the [[Wolf Division]] to reinforce himself. Although he lacks certain bloodline armors used by his descendants, his combat abilities are highly refined through centuries of experience. He possesses a deep love for fighting and can become intensely focused or even crazed with excitement when facing enemies. Despite his combat-oriented nature, he is also capable of being insightful and showing interest in those with potential. He is married to an [[Archlady]] named [[Aunt Naria|Naria]].}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Sky's Edge conflict}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|During the [[Sky's Edge]] conflict, Fury found himself pinned by [[Gold dragons|gold dragons]] and [[Dreadgod cults]] while facing threats from enemy [[Heralds]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c21">''Wintersteel'', chapter 21</ref> [[Malice]] considers Fury someone she would [[sacrifice]] for her family and intends to save him.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c22">''Wintersteel'', chapter 22</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c26">''Wintersteel'', chapter 26</ref> Tasked with watching over [[Lindon]]'s team to prevent [[Herald]] interference, Fury shared information regarding a way out with [[Mercy]] and others.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c24">''Wintersteel'', chapter 24</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c25">''Wintersteel'', chapter 25</ref> [[Yerin]] noted that Fury's eyes were similar to her own, and [[Lindon]] sought proximity to him to obtain a battle report.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c26" /> As he ascends to [[Monarch]], Fury utilizes the [[Authority|authority]] of a [[Sage]] and possesses two different sources of [[Authority|authority]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c26" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c28">''Wintersteel'', chapter 28</ref> After [[Lindon]] instructs [[Dross]] to convey a message, Fury receives a report concerning [[Yerin]] becoming a half-[[Herald]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c27">''Wintersteel'', chapter 27</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c28" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Abidan member}} ===
